headline: Great Migration of Retirement Pensions... 60 Trillion Won Flows into ETFs [Retirement Pension ETF Era]
summary: About 60 trillion won of retirement pension funds has been invested in exchange-traded funds. The money is believed to have shifted into risk assets such as stocks.
why: Korean retirement pension funds are large institutional investors, and their allocation shifts can affect domestic equity and ETF flows.
